Raw hex address 0x4a826d assigned to bare local `uStack_454`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `uStack_454` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

*(...)(pcVar3 + 0x35e8) reaches field char_widths (0x35e8) of CBitFont via a baked 32-bit offset. CBitFont is 64-bit-unstable (grows past its first pointer/unstable field at 0x194); on the 64-bit build field offsets at/after 0x194 shift, so this reads/writes the wrong bytes. De-pun to named field access on a CBitFont * (§de-pun/§12).
